final:
shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 7) == []
  ex shuffled([5], 3) == [5]
  var ys: List[int] = []
  for x in xs
    ys.append(x)
  let n = ys.len()
  var state = seed % 2147483647
  if state == 0
    state = 1
  for k in range(1, n)
    let i = n - k
    state = (state * 48271) % 2147483647
    let j = state % (i + 1)
    let a = ys[i]
    let b = ys[j]
    ys[i] = b
    ys[j] = a
  ys
